cat > checks/access.py <<'PY'
import os
import sqlite3
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())

from src.repository import initialize
from src.service import get_document, list_documents

connection = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
initialize(connection)
tenant = "tenant' OR 1=1 --"
owner = "owner' OR 1=1 --"
connection.executemany(
    "INSERT INTO documents VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
    [
        (5, tenant, owner, "Later", "Later body", None),
        (1, tenant, owner, "First", "First body", None),
        (2, "other tenant", owner, "Private", "Private body", None),
        (3, tenant, "other owner", "Private", "Private body", None),
        (4, tenant, owner, "Deleted", "Deleted body", "2026-01-01"),
        (6, tenant, owner, "Also deleted", "Body", ""),
    ],
)
expected = [
    {"id": 1, "title": "First", "body": "First body"},
    {"id": 5, "title": "Later", "body": "Later body"},
]
assert list_documents(connection, tenant, owner) == expected
for document in expected:
    assert get_document(connection, tenant, owner, document["id"]) == document
for document_id in (2, 3, 4, 6, 99, "1 OR 1=1"):
    assert get_document(connection, tenant, owner, document_id) is None
assert list_documents(connection, "missing", owner) == []
assert list_documents(connection, tenant, "missing") == []
assert get_document(connection, "missing", owner, 1) is None
assert get_document(connection, tenant, "missing", 1) is None
connection.close()
PY
python3 checks/public.py && python3 checks/access.py
